eyebrow: QUALITY · SUPPLIER AUDIT · ISO 9001:2015 · EU GMP ANNEX 15 · ASME BPE
headline: Audit our quality system before you award the contract
lead: Your quality unit has to qualify us as a supplier before our water system goes into your plant: ISO 13485 7.4 asks it of device makers, and your factory acceptance test (FAT) results only stand in qualification (EU GMP Annex 15, 3.6) if your quality unit trusts the supplier that produced them. This page shows how our quality management system (QMS) works, process by process: document control, change control, nonconformance and corrective and preventive action (CAPA), supplier control, calibration, training and internal audit, each with the record it leaves. [ISO 9001 status: certificate, registrar and expiry, or target certification date.] Audit us on site or remotely, or start with our quality questionnaire pack.

blocks.h: A supplier audit tests whether records are made by a system or by memory
body: An auditor qualifying a water system supplier does not stop at the quality manual. They pick a weld, a certificate or a change and ask to see how it was controlled: who approved the drawing revision, which instrument took the reading and when it was last calibrated, what happened to the weld that failed borescope. If the answer is a person remembering, the finding is the supplier's, and the risk becomes yours at installation qualification (IQ).

So our QMS is written as procedures that each produce a record, and the records are the ones that land in your turnover package. [ISO 9001 status: certified by [registrar], certificate [number], scope [scope], expiry [date]; or: QMS built to the clauses of ISO 9001:2015, certification targeted for [date].] The tables below name the ISO 9001:2015 clause each process answers so your auditor can map it to your own supplier checklist. Where your quality agreement or user requirement specification (URS) asks for more, it governs and is written into the project quality plan.

blocks.h: Our quality processes and the record each one leaves
rows: Document control
Every specification, drawing, protocol and procedure carries a number, revision and approval. Only the current revision is issued to the shop and site; superseded revisions are withdrawn and kept
Document register with revision history; comment log for each client document
Change control
Any change to a design, material, procedure or software after approval is raised, assessed for impact, approved and recorded before work continues
Change request with impact assessment; change control register
Change control register in the turnover package
Nonconformance and CAPA
Material, welds, components or test results that do not meet the specification are identified, held, dispositioned and closed; repeat or systemic causes get a CAPA
Nonconformance report (NCR); CAPA record with effectiveness check; deviation logs at FAT, site acceptance test (SAT), IQ and operational qualification (OQ)
Deviation and nonconformance log with closure
Supplier control
Suppliers of product-contact material, components and special processes are approved before use and reviewed on a schedule
Approved supplier list; supplier evaluation and review records; incoming inspection records
Identification and traceability
Every product-contact component traced by heat, lot or serial number from receipt to the weld and the drawing
Material log cross-referenced to EN 10204 3.1 certificates; weld log; weld maps
Calibration
Test and measuring instruments calibrated on a schedule against references traceable to national standards; out-of-tolerance results reviewed for impact
Calibration register; calibration certificates with as-found and as-left values
Calibration certificates in the turnover package
Competence and training
Each role has its required qualifications and training; welders, inspectors and test engineers work only within current qualifications
Training matrix by role; training records; welding operator performance qualification (WOPQ) and continuity log for orbital welders
Welding operator qualifications; training records at handover
Internal audit and management review
Each process audited on a schedule by someone independent of it; results, CAPA status and supplier performance reviewed by management
Internal audit schedule and reports; management review minutes
Audit schedule and a summary of findings, on request at your supplier audit
Customer feedback and complaints
Complaints and field issues logged, investigated and closed, and fed back into CAPA
Complaint log; service reports; CAPA record

blocks.h: Change control: what happens when something changes after you approve it

items.d: Anyone can raise a change request: a different valve, a revised setpoint, a routing change, a substitute material. It names the documents it touches, at their current revision.
Engineering and quality assess the impact on water quality, the critical aspects and critical design elements, the drawings, the functional specification and any test already executed.
A change to a document your team approved goes to your team before it is made. Internal-only changes are approved by Aquemi quality. Nothing is built to an unapproved revision.
Documents reissued at the next revision, superseded copies withdrawn from the shop and site, and the shop briefed.
The test that proves the change is run or repeated, for example a FAT test case, a software version and checksum record, or a pressure test after a piping change.

Closed in the change control register, which travels with the turnover package. After handover, changes you request run through your change control, with our impact assessment input (EU GMP Annex 15, section 11).

blocks.h: Nonconformance and CAPA: how a defect is found, held and closed
rows: Identify and hold

The item is tagged and segregated, or the work stopped, so it cannot move to the next step by mistake. Examples: a heat that does not match its certificate, a weld that fails borescope, a test result outside its acceptance criterion
Whoever finds it
NCR raised, with a number, the item and the requirement it fails
Disposition
Reject and replace, rework to the original requirement, or accept as is. A rejected product-contact weld is cut out, not ground or re-fused, and the replacement gets a new weld number
Aquemi quality. Accept as is, or any repair that departs from an approved document, needs your approval
Disposition and approval on the NCR; weld log link from the rejected weld to its replacement
Root cause
For repeat, systemic or client-reported nonconformances, the cause is investigated, not just the item fixed
Aquemi quality, with the process owner
Investigation on the CAPA record
Corrective and preventive action
The procedure, training, supplier or equipment changed so the cause does not recur, and other work at risk checked
Aquemi quality
CAPA record; any procedure change runs through document control
Effectiveness check
Evidence after an agreed period that the action worked, before the CAPA is closed
Aquemi quality; reviewed at management review
Effectiveness check signed on the CAPA record
Reported to you

Nonconformances on your system are listed in the deviation and nonconformance log. One found after shipment that could affect your qualified system is notified to you within [notification time for nonconformances found after shipment, working days]
Aquemi quality
Deviation and nonconformance log with closure, in the turnover package

blocks.h: Supplier control: what we require from the people who supply us
rows: Tubing and fittings, product contact
316L stainless steel to ASME BPE, marked so the heat stays traceable; an EN 10204 3.1 inspection certificate for every heat. A type 2.2 test report is not accepted
Marking checked against the certificate at receipt; [positive material identification (PMI) by X-ray fluorescence, standard or option]
Material log with EN 10204 3.1 certificates, by heat number
Valves, instruments and other components
Product-contact materials and finish as specified, with certificates; serial numbers for instruments
Receipt inspection against the purchase order and datasheet
Component certificates; instrument list with serial numbers
Elastomers and gaskets
USP <88> Class VI and FDA 21 CFR 177.2600, a certificate for each compound and grade
Compound and grade checked against the certificate; replacement like for like only
Elastomer compliance statements
Membranes, electrodeionization (EDI), ultrafiltration (UF), media and resin
Manufacturer's certificates with serial or lot numbers
Serial and lot numbers recorded at receipt and at installation
Membrane, EDI, UF, media and resin certificates
Electropolishing
SF4: Ra ≤ 0.38 µm (15 µin) electropolished to ASME BPE. [State whether electropolishing is done in-house or by a named subcontractor]
Supplier approved before use; profilometer Ra readings on receipt
Electropolish certificate per component; surface finish report
Passivation
To ASTM A967, or ASTM A380 for assembled systems. [State whether shop passivation is done in-house or by a named subcontractor, and whether site passivation is done by Aquemi staff]
Certificate checked for standard, chemistry, temperature, contact time and verification test
Passivation certificate per system
Calibration services
Calibration traceable to national standards. [Calibration provider and accreditation, for example ISO/IEC 17025]
Certificate reviewed for as-found and as-left values, uncertainty and reference standard
Calibration certificates
Pressure vessels and control panels

Vessels to ASME Section VIII, Division 1, with a Canadian registration number (CRN) under CSA B51 in the province of installation; panels to CSA C22.2 No. 286 or UL 508A. [Certified vessel fabricator or in-house; panel shop and mark]
Design documents and data reports reviewed; panel label checked
Manufacturer's data report; CRN registration; panel certification record
Supplier review
Every approved supplier reviewed every [supplier review interval, months] on quality, delivery and certificate errors. A supplier with an open CAPA is not used for your order until it is closed
Supplier performance data; supplier audits where risk warrants [supplier audit practice]
Approved supplier list, shared at your supplier audit

blocks.h: Questions quality and procurement teams ask

items.a: [State Aquemi's ISO 9001 status: certificate number, registrar, scope and expiry, or the QMS built to ISO 9001:2015 and the target certification date.] Either way, your supplier qualification can test the system itself: the processes on this page, the records they leave and a sample traced end to end at an audit.

items.q: Can we audit you before we place the order?
items.a: Yes. We prefer it, because a supplier audit before award settles questions that would otherwise reach your IQ. Remote or on site at [shop and office location, city and province], with [on-site audit notice, working days] notice. [Confirm whether supplier audits are free of charge before order.]

items.q: Will you sign our quality agreement?
items.a: Send it with the request for proposal and we mark it up with the quote. The clauses we look at first are change notification, audit rights, subcontracting, record retention and how fast we tell you about a nonconformance. [Confirm Aquemi returns quality agreements with the quote, and the usual turnaround.]

items.q: Will you tell us before you change a material, supplier or design?
items.a: Before order, a change to a document you approved goes to you for approval before it is made. After handover, a change to your system runs through your change control, with our impact assessment. A change to a component or supplier for spare parts is made like for like only; anything else is notified to you before supply.

items.q: Do you audit your own subcontractors?
items.a: Every supplier of product-contact material and special processes, such as electropolishing and passivation, is approved before use and reviewed every [supplier review interval, months]. [State whether Aquemi audits critical subcontractors on site, and how often.] Their certificates reach you as the issuer sent them, never retyped.

items.q: Who in your company can stop shipment?
items.a: [Name the role that releases a system to ship, for example the quality manager, and confirm it reports independently of production.] A system does not leave the shop with an open NCR on a product-contact item unless you have approved the disposition, and open items are listed on the FAT punch list with an owner and a date.

items.q: We are an industrial plant. Do you handle contractor prequalification?
items.a: Yes. Procurement usually needs insurance certificates, a safety programme, workers' compensation clearance and registration on a contractor platform before a site visit. [Confirm the platforms Aquemi is registered on and the safety certification held.] The questionnaire pack carries these documents, so onboarding does not wait for an engineer.

items.q: How long do you keep quality records?
items.a: We keep project quality records, including NCRs, change requests and calibration certificates, for [quality record retention, years], and a copy of each turnover package for the period stated on the documentation page. Your site's own retention rules apply to your master copy.
